title: Unified 4D World Action Modeling from Video Priors with Asynchronous Denoising
summary: We propose X-WAM, a Unified 4D World Model that unifies real-time robotic action execution and high-fidelity 4D world synthesis (video + 3D reconstruction) in a single framework, addressing the critical limitations of prior unified world models (e.g., UWM) that only model 2D pixel-space and fail to balance action efficiency and world modeling quality. To leverage the strong visual priors of pretrained video diffusion models, X-WAM imagines the future world by predicting multi-view RGB-D videos, and obtains spatial information efficiently through a lightweight structural adaptation: replicating the final few blocks of the pretrained Diffusion Transformer into a dedicated depth prediction branch for the reconstruction of future spatial information. Moreover, we propose Asynchronous Noise Sampling (ANS) to jointly optimize generation quality and action decoding efficiency. ANS applies a specialized asynchronous denoising schedule during inference, which rapidly decodes actions with fewer steps to enable efficient real-time execution, while dedicating the full sequence of steps to generate high-fidelity video. Rather than entirely decoupling the timesteps during training, ANS samples from their joint distribution to align with the inference distribution. Pretrained on over 5,800 hours of robotic data, X-WAM achieves 79.2% and 90.7% average success rate on RoboCasa and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks, while producing high-fidelity 4D reconstruction and generation surpassing existing methods in both visual and geometric metrics.
tldr: The paper proposes X-WAM, a unified 4D world model that integrates real-time robot action execution and high-fidelity 4D world synthesis by leveraging video diffusion priors and an asynchronous denoising schedule.
tldr_zh: 本文提出X-WAM，一个统一的4D世界模型，它利用视频扩散先验和异步去噪调度，将实时机器人动作执行与高保真4D世界合成集成在一个框架中。
summary_zh: 本文提出X-WAM，一种统一4D世界模型，将实时机器人动作执行与高保真4D世界合成（视频+三维重建）融合于单一框架，解决了现有统一世界模型（如UWM）仅建模二维像素空间、无法平衡动作效率与世界建模质量的关键局限。为利用预训练视频扩散模型的强视觉先验，X-WAM通过预测多视角RGB-D视频构建未来世界想象，并采用轻量化结构适配高效获取空间信息：将预训练扩散Transformer的末层模块复制为专用深度预测分支，以重建未来空间信息。此外，我们提出异步噪声采样（ANS）技术，联合优化生成质量与动作解码效率。ANS在推理阶段采用专用异步去噪调度，通过较少步数快速解码动作以实现高效实时执行，同时保留完整步数序列生成高保真视频。ANS通过从联合分布中采样而非训练阶段完全解耦时间步，使其与推理分布对齐。在超过5，800小时机器人数据预训练基础上，X-WAM在RoboCasa与RoboTwin 2.0基准测试中分别达到79.2%与90.7%的平均成功率，其生成的高保真4D重建与合成结果在视觉与几何指标上均超越现有方法。

title: STARRY: Spatial-Temporal Action-Centric World Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation critically requires reasoning about future spatial-temporal interactions, yet existing VLA policies and world-model-enhanced policies do not fully model action-relevant spatial-temporal interaction structure. We propose STARRY, a world-model-enhanced action-generation policy that aligns spatial-temporal prediction with action generation. STARRY jointly denoises future spatial-temporal latents and action sequences, and introduces Geometry-Aware Selective Attention Modulation to convert predicted depth and end-effector geometry into token-aligned weights for selective action-attention modulation. On RoboTwin 2.0, STARRY achieves 93.82% / 93.30% average success under Clean and Randomized settings. Real-world experiments further improve average success from 42.5% to 70.8% over $π_{0.5}$, demonstrating the effectiveness of action-centric spatial-temporal world modeling for spatial-temporally demanding robotic action generation.
tldr: The paper introduces STARRY, a world-model-enhanced action-generation policy that jointly denoises future spatial-temporal latents and action sequences for robotic manipulation, improving real-world success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了STARRY，一种世界模型增强的动作生成策略，通过联合去噪未来时空潜在表征和动作序列，提升了机器人操作在真实世界中的成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人操作的核心在于对未来时空交互的推理，然而现有的视觉语言行动策略与世界模型增强策略未能充分建模与动作相关的时空交互结构。本文提出STARRY——一种将时空预测与动作生成对齐的世界模型增强型动作生成策略。该方法通过联合去噪未来时空隐变量与动作序列，并引入几何感知选择性注意力调制机制，将预测的深度与末端执行器几何信息转化为面向令牌对齐的权重，以实现对动作注意力的选择性调制。在RoboTwin 2.0实验中，STARRY在基准场景与随机化场景下分别达到93.82%与93.30%的平均成功率。真实世界实验进一步将平均成功率从基准策略$π_{0.5}$的42.5%提升至70.8%，验证了以动作为核心的时空世界建模对高时空要求机器人动作生成的有效性。

title: Walk With Me: Long-Horizon Social Navigation for Human-Centric Outdoor Assistance
summary: Assisting humans in open-world outdoor environments requires robots to translate high-level natural-language intentions into safe, long-horizon, and socially compliant navigation behavior. Existing map-based methods rely on costly pre-built HD maps, while learning-based policies are mostly limited to indoor and short-horizon settings. To bridge this gap, we propose Walk with Me, a map-free framework for long-horizon social navigation from high-level human instructions. Walk with Me leverages GPS context and lightweight candidate points-of-interest from a public map API for semantic destination grounding and waypoint proposal. A High-Level Vision-Language Model grounds abstract instructions into concrete destinations and plans coarse waypoint sequences. During execution, an observation-aware routing mechanism determines whether the Low-Level Vision-Language-Action policy can handle the current situation or whether explicit safety reasoning from the High-Level VLM is needed. Routine segments are executed by the Low-Level VLA, while complex situations such as crowded crossings trigger high-level reasoning and stop-and-wait behavior when unsafe. By combining semantic intent grounding, map-free long-horizon planning, safety-aware reasoning, and low-level action generation, Walk with Me enables practical outdoor social navigation for human-centric assistance.
tldr: Proposes a map-free framework for long-horizon outdoor social navigation, using a high-level VLM for semantic grounding and planning and a low-level VLA policy for execution with safety-aware routing.
tldr_zh: 提出一个无需地图的户外长程社会导航框架，利用高层VLM进行语义落地和规划，结合低层VLA策略进行执行，并具备安全感知的路由机制。
summary_zh: 在开放世界的户外环境中协助人类，需要机器人将高级自然语言意图转化为安全、长距离且符合社会规范的导航行为。现有的基于地图的方法依赖成本高昂的预建高精度地图，而基于学习的策略大多局限于室内或短距离场景。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了"与我同行"（Walk with Me）框架——一种无需地图的、能够根据人类高级指令实现长距离社交导航的系统。该框架利用公共地图API提供的GPS背景信息和轻量级候选兴趣点，进行语义目的地定位和路径点规划。高级视觉语言模型将抽象指令转化为具体目的地，并规划出粗略的路径点序列。在执行过程中，观测感知路由机制会判断当前场景应由低级视觉-语言-动作策略处理，还是需要启动高级视觉语言模型进行显式安全推理。常规路段由低级视觉-语言-动作策略执行，而复杂场景（如拥挤的十字路口）则触发高级推理模块，并在不安全情况下启动暂停等待行为。通过融合语义意图理解、无地图长距离规划、安全感知推理和低层动作生成，"与我同行"框架实现了以人为中心的实用化户外社交导航。

title: Atomic-Probe Governance for Skill Updates in Compositional Robot Policies
summary: Skill libraries in deployed robotic systems are continually updated through fine-tuning, fresh demonstrations, or domain adaptation, yet existing typed-composition methods (BLADE, SymSkill, Generative Skill Chaining) treat the library as frozen at test time and do not analyze how composition outcomes change when a skill is replaced. We introduce a paired-sampling cross-version swap protocol on robosuite manipulation tasks to characterize this dimension of compositional skill learning. On a dual-arm peg-in-hole task we discover a dominant-skill effect: one ECM achieves 86.7% atomic success rate while every other ECM is at or below 26.7%, and whether this dominant ECM enters a composition shifts the success rate by up to +50pp. We characterize the boundary on a simpler pick task where all atomic policies saturate at 100% and the effect is undefined. Across three tasks we further find that off-policy behavioral distance metrics fail to identify the dominant ECM, ruling out the natural cheap predictor. We propose an atomic-quality probe and a Hybrid Selector combining per-skill probes (zero per-decision cost) with selective composition revalidation (full cost), and characterize its Pareto frontier on 144 skill-update decisions. On T6 the atomic-only probe sits 23pp below full revalidation (64.6% vs 87.5% oracle match) at zero per-decision cost; a Hybrid Selector with m=10 closes most of that gap to ~12pp at 46% of full-revalidation cost. On the cross-task average over 144 events, atomic-only is within 3pp of full revalidation under a mixed-oracle caveat. The atomic-quality probe is, to our knowledge, the first principled, deployment-ready primitive for skill-update governance in compositional robot policies.
tldr: This paper introduces an atomic-quality probe and a hybrid selector for governing skill updates in compositional robot policies, addressing the problem of how compositional outcomes change when a single skill is replaced in a library.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于组合机器人策略中技能更新治理的原子质量探针和混合选择器，解决了当技能库中单个技能被替换时组合结果如何变化的问题。
summary_zh: 已部署机器人系统中的技能库通过微调、新演示或领域适应等方式持续更新，然而现有的类型化组合方法（如BLADE、SymSkill、Generative Skill Chaining）在测试时均将技能库视为固定不变，且未分析技能替换对组合结果的影响。我们提出一种基于robosuite操作任务的配对采样跨版本交换协议，以刻画组合技能学习中这一维度的特性。在双臂孔轴装配任务中，我们发现了主导技能效应：一个ECM（执行器控制模块）的原子成功率高达86.7%，而其他所有ECM均低于或等于26.7%，且该主导ECM是否参与组合会使成功率产生高达±50个百分点的波动。我们通过更简单的抓取任务界定该效应的边界：当所有原子策略均达到100%成功率时，该效应消失。在三个任务中，我们进一步发现基于离线策略的行为距离度量无法识别主导ECM，排除了自然廉价预测器的可行性。我们提出原子质量探测器和混合选择器，前者结合了各技能探测器（单次决策零成本）与选择性组合重验证（全成本），并在144次技能更新决策中刻画其帕累托前沿。在T6任务中，纯原子探测器在零单次决策成本下比全重验证低23个百分点（64.6% vs 87.5%理想匹配度）；采用m=10参数的混合选择器以46%的全重验证成本将差距缩小至约12个百分点。在跨任务平均的144个事件中，考虑混合理想条件约束，纯原子探测器的性能与全重验证相差在3个百分点以内。据我们所知，原子质量探测器是首个具有理论依据、可直接部署的机器人组合策略技能更新治理原语。

title: Three-Step Nav: A Hierarchical Global-Local Planner for Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Breakthrough progress in vision-based navigation through unknown environments has been achieved by using multimodal large language models (MLLMs). These models can plan a sequence of motions by evaluating the current view at each time step against the task and goal given to the agent. However, current zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) agents powered by MLLMs still tend to drift off course, halt prematurely, and achieve low overall success rates. We propose Three-Step Nav to counteract these failures with a three-view protocol: First, "look forward" to extract global landmarks and sketch a coarse plan. Then, "look now" to align the current visual observation with the next sub-goal for fine-grained guidance. Finally, "look backward" audits the entire trajectory to correct accumulated drift before stopping. Requiring no gradient updates or task-specific fine-tuning, our planner drops into existing VLN pipelines with minimal overhead. Three-Step Nav achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE dataset. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZoeyZheng0/3-step-Nav.
tldr: The paper introduces Three-Step Nav, a hierarchical zero-shot planner for vision-and-language navigation that uses a three-view protocol (look forward, look now, look backward) to improve robustness and success rate without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Three-Step Nav，一种用于视觉语言导航的零样本分层规划器，通过前视、当前视和后视的三视图协议，在不进行微调的情况下提高鲁棒性和成功率。
summary_zh: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的视觉导航技术在未知环境探索中取得了突破性进展。这类模型能够通过对比智能体当前任务目标与每一时间步的观测视图，规划出一系列动作序列。然而，当前基于MLLM的零样本视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体仍存在路径偏离、提前终止及整体成功率较低的问题。我们提出“三步导航法”以应对这些缺陷，该方法采用三重视角协议：首先“向前看”，提取全局地标并勾勒粗略规划；接着“看当下”，将当前视觉观测与下一子目标对齐以实现细粒度引导；最后“回头看”，在停止前审核完整轨迹以修正累积漂移。该规划器无需梯度更新或任务特定微调，能以最小开销嵌入现有VLN流程。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE数据集上，三步导航法实现了零样本导航的最先进性能。代码已开源：https://github.com/ZoeyZheng0/3-step-Nav。

title: Stochastic Entanglement of Deterministic Origami Tentacles For Universal Robotic Gripping
summary: Origami-inspired robotic grippers have shown promising potential for object manipulation tasks due to their compact volume and mechanical flexibility. However, robust capture of objects with random shapes in dynamic working environments often comes at the cost of additional actuation channels and control complexity. Here, we introduce a tendon-driven origami tentacle gripper capable of universal object gripping by exploiting a synergy between local, deterministic deformation programming and global, stochastic entanglements. Each origami tentacle is made by cutting thin Mylar sheets; It features carefully placed holes for routing an actuation tendon, origami creases for controlling the deformation, and a tapered shape. By tailoring these design features, one can prescribe the shrinking, bending, and twisting deformation, eventually creating deterministic coiling with a simple tendon pull. Then, when multiple coiling tentacles are placed in proximity, stochastic entanglement emerges, allowing the tentacles to braid, knot, and grip objects with random shapes. We derived a simulation model by integrating origami mechanics with Cosserat rods to correlate origami design, tendon deformation, and their collective gripping performance. Then, we experimentally tested how these coiling and entangling origami tentacles can grasp objects under gravity and in water. A stow-and-release deployment mechanism was also tested to simulate in-orbit grasping. Overall, the entertaining origami tentacle gripper presents a new strategy for robust object grasping with simple design and actuation.
tldr: The paper introduces a novel tendon-driven origami tentacle gripper that exploits deterministic coiling and stochastic entanglement to achieve universal object grasping with simple actuation, tested under gravity, water, and simulated orbital conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型腱驱动折纸触手机器人抓手，它利用确定性卷曲和随机缠结原理，通过简单的驱动即可实现通用物体抓取，并在地球重力、水下及模拟轨道条件下进行了测试。
summary_zh: 受折纸启发的机器人抓手因其紧凑的体积和机械灵活性，在物体操控任务中展现出广阔潜力。然而，在动态工作环境中稳健抓取随机形状的物体往往需要额外的驱动通道并增加控制复杂度。本文提出一种线驱折纸触手机器抓手，通过融合局部确定性形变编程与全局随机纠缠机制，实现通用物体抓取。每个折纸触手由切割聚酯薄膜制成，其设计包含精确定位的穿线孔、控制形变的折纸折痕以及锥形结构。通过调整这些设计特征，可实现收缩、弯曲和扭曲形变，最终仅通过单线拉动即可产生确定性盘绕行为。当多个盘绕触手相邻放置时，会自发产生随机纠缠现象，使触手能够编织、打结并抓取任意形状的物体。我们整合折纸力学与Cosserat杆理论建立了仿真模型，用以关联折纸设计、线驱动形变与整体抓取性能。随后通过实验测试了这些盘绕纠缠式折纸触手在重力环境及水下抓取物体的能力，并验证了可收放式展开机构在模拟轨道抓取场景中的应用。总体而言，这种具备缠绕特性的折纸触手机器抓手以简洁的设计与驱动方式，为鲁棒物体抓取提供了新策略。

title: LLM-Flax : Generalizable Robotic Task Planning via Neuro-Symbolic Approaches with Large Language Models
summary: Deploying a neuro-symbolic task planner on a new domain today requires significant manual effort: a domain expert must author relaxation and complementary rules, and hundreds of training problems must be solved to supervise a Graph Neural Network (GNN) object scorer. We propose LLM-Flax, a three-stage framework that eliminates all three sources of manual effort using a locally hosted LLM given only a PDDL domain file. Stage 1 automatically generates relaxation and complementary rules via structured prompting with format validation and self-correction. Stage 2 introduces LLM-guided failure recovery with a feasibility-gated budget policy that explicitly reserves API latency cost before each LLM call, preventing the downstream relaxation fallback from being starved. Stage 3 replaces the domain-trained GNN entirely with zero-shot LLM object importance scoring, requiring no training data. We evaluate all three stages on the MazeNamo benchmark across 10x10, 12x12, and 15x15 grids (8 benchmarks total). LLM-Flax achieves average SR 0.945 versus the manual baseline's 0.828 (+0.117), matching or outperforming manual rules on every one of the eight benchmarks. On 12x12 Expert, LLM-Flax attains SR 0.733 where the manual planner fails entirely (SR 0.000); on 15x15 Hard, it achieves SR 1.000 versus Manual's 0.900. Stage 3 demonstrates feasibility (SR 0.720 on 12x12 Hard with no training data) but faces a context-window bottleneck at scale, pointing to the primary open challenge for future work.
tldr: LLM-Flax is a neuro-symbolic robotic task planning framework that uses a local LLM to automatically generate planning rules, guide failure recovery, and perform zero-shot object scoring, eliminating manual engineering.
tldr_zh: LLM-Flax 是一个神经符号机器人任务规划框架，它使用本地LLM自动生成规划规则、指导故障恢复和执行零样本对象评分，从而消除了手动工程需求。
summary_zh: 目前，在全新领域部署神经符号任务规划器需要大量人工投入：领域专家需手动编写松弛规则与互补规则，并且需解决数百个训练问题以指导图神经网络（GNN）对象评分器的训练。本文提出 LLM-Flax，这是一个三阶段框架，仅基于给定的 PDDL 领域文件，通过本地部署的大型语言模型（LLM）完全消除上述三方面的人工负担。第一阶段通过结构化提示、格式验证与自校正机制，自动生成松弛规则与互补规则。第二阶段引入 LLM 引导的故障恢复策略，采用可行性门控预算机制，在每次调用 LLM 前明确预留 API 延迟成本，避免下游松弛回退过程因资源不足而失效。第三阶段完全摒弃了依赖领域训练的 GNN，采用零样本 LLM 对象重要性评分方法，无需任何训练数据。我们在 MazeNamo 基准测试的 10x10、12x12 及 15x15 网格上（共 8 个基准任务）对全部三个阶段进行了评估。LLM-Flax 的平均成功率达到 0.945，而人工基线为 0.828（提升 0.117），在全部八个基准任务中均达到或超越了人工规则的效果。在 12x12 专家难度任务中，人工规划器完全失败（成功率 0.000），而 LLM-Flax 取得了 0.733 的成功率；在 15x15 困难任务中，LLM-Flax 实现 1.000 的成功率，而人工方法为 0.900。第三阶段验证了零样本评分方法的可行性（在 12x12 困难任务上无需训练数据即达到 0.720 成功率），但在规模扩展时面临上下文窗口限制的瓶颈，这为未来工作指明了主要的开放挑战。

title: HiPAN: Hierarchical Posture-Adaptive Navigation for Quadruped Robots in Unstructured 3D Environments
summary: Navigating quadruped robots in unstructured 3D environments poses significant challenges, requiring goal-directed motion, effective exploration to escape from local minima, and posture adaptation to traverse narrow, height-constrained spaces. Conventional approaches employ a sequential mapping-planning pipeline but suffer from accumulated perception errors and high computational overhead, restricting their applicability on resource-constrained platforms. To address these challenges, we propose Hierarchical Posture-Adaptive Navigation (HiPAN), a framework that operates directly on onboard depth images at deployment. HiPAN adopts a hierarchical design: a high-level policy generates strategic navigation commands (planar velocity and body posture), which are executed by a low-level, posture-adaptive locomotion controller. To mitigate myopic behaviors and facilitate long-horizon navigation, we introduce Path-Guided Curriculum Learning, which progressively extends the navigation horizon from reactive obstacle avoidance to strategic navigation. In simulation, HiPAN achieves higher navigation success rates and greater path efficiency than classical reactive planners and end-to-end baselines, while real-world experiments further validate its applicability across diverse, unstructured 3D environments.
tldr: HiPAN is a hierarchical navigation framework for quadruped robots that uses a high-level policy to generate navigation commands from onboard depth images, coupled with a low-level posture-adaptive locomotion controller, trained with a curriculum to improve long-horizon performance in unstructured 3D environments.
tldr_zh: HiPAN 是一种用于四足机器人的分层导航框架，利用高层策略根据机载深度图像生成导航指令，结合低层姿态自适应运动控制器，并通过课程学习提升其在非结构化 3D 环境中的长程导航性能。
summary_zh: 四足机器人在非结构化三维环境中的导航面临重大挑战，需要实现目标导向运动、有效探索以摆脱局部极小值，并通过姿态调整穿越狭窄且高度受限的空间。传统方法采用顺序式的建图-规划流程，但存在感知误差累积与计算开销过高的问题，限制了其在资源受限平台上的应用。为应对这些挑战，我们提出层次化姿态自适应导航框架，该框架可直接在部署时基于机载深度图像进行实时操作。该框架采用分层设计：高层策略生成战略导航指令（平面速度与身体姿态），由低层姿态自适应运动控制器执行。为克服短视行为并实现长时程导航，我们提出路径引导课程学习方法，通过渐进式训练将导航视野从反应式避障扩展至战略性导航。仿真实验表明，相比经典反应式规划器与端到端基线方法，该框架在导航成功率和路径效率上均表现更优，而真实世界实验进一步验证了其在多样化非结构化三维环境中的适用性。

title: Robot Planning and Situation Handling with Active Perception
summary: Current robots are capable of computing plans to accomplish complex tasks. However, real-world environments are inherently open and dynamic, and unforeseen situations frequently arise during plan execution, such as jamming doors and fallen objects on the floor. These situations may result from the robot's own action failures or from external disturbances, such as human activities. Detecting and handling such execution - time situations remains a significant challenge, limiting those robots' ability to achieve long-term autonomy. In this paper, we develop a planning and situation-handling framework, called VAP-TAMP, that enables robots to actively perceive and address unforeseen situations during plan execution. VAP-TAMP leverages action knowledge to strategically prompt vision-language models for active view selection and situation assessment, while constructing and reasoning over scene graphs for integrated task and motion planning. We evaluated VAP-TAMP using service tasks in simulation and on a mobile manipulation platform.
tldr: This paper introduces VAP-TAMP, a planning framework that uses vision-language models and scene graphs to enable robots to actively perceive and handle unforeseen situations during task execution.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了VAP-TAMP规划框架，利用视觉语言模型和场景图，使机器人能够在任务执行过程中主动感知并处理意外情况。
summary_zh: 当前机器人在规划以完成复杂任务方面已具备计算能力。然而现实环境本质上是开放且动态的，计划执行过程中常会遭遇意外情况，例如门被卡住或地面有散落物体。这些情况可能源于机器人自身动作执行失败，也可能由外部干扰（如人类活动）引发。如何检测与处理此类执行过程中的突发状况，仍然是制约机器人实现长期自主运行能力的关键挑战。本文提出一种名为VAP-TAMP的规划与情境处理框架，使机器人能够在执行计划时主动感知并应对意外状况。该框架通过运用动作知识，策略性地引导视觉-语言模型进行主动视角选择与情境评估，同时构建场景图并进行推理，实现任务规划与运动规划的有机融合。我们在仿真环境和移动操作平台上，通过服务任务对VAP-TAMP框架进行了系统性评估。

title: FlowS: One-Step Motion Prediction via Local Transport Conditioning
summary: Generative motion prediction must satisfy three simultaneous requirements for real-world autonomy: high accuracy, diverse multimodal futures, and strictly bounded latency. Diffusion models meet the first two but violate the third, requiring tens to hundreds of denoising steps. We identify a conditioning strategy that resolves this tension: \textit{single-step integration is accurate when the underlying transport problem is local}. A model that must both discover the correct behavioral mode and traverse a long displacement in one step accumulates large discretization errors; conditioning the base distribution to lie near plausible futures reduces the problem to short-range refinement, the regime where a single Euler step suffices. We instantiate this \emph{local transport conditioning} in FlowS, a conditional flow matching framework with two mechanisms. First, an online, scene-conditioned learned prior emits $K$ calibrated anchor trajectories per agent, each already near a plausible future, converting mode discovery into local correction. Second, a step-consistent displacement field enforces semigroup self-consistency, guaranteeing that a single step inherits multi-step accuracy. Crucially, anchoring this field at learned priors along straight-line paths yields a {stable, low-variance} training target, unlike prior self-consistency methods that suffer from {high-variance bootstrap} signals on curved diffusion paths. On the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, FlowS achieves state-of-the-art Soft mAP {(0.4804) and mAP (0.4703) with ensemble at 75\,FPS} with single-step inference, demonstrating that local transport conditioning makes one-step generative motion prediction practical for safety-critical autonomy. Code and pretrained models will be released upon acceptance.
tldr: FlowS is a single-step generative motion prediction model for autonomous driving that uses local transport conditioning and a scene-conditioned prior to achieve high accuracy, diversity, and low latency on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset.
tldr_zh: FlowS是一种用于自动驾驶的单步生成式运动预测模型，通过局部传输条件化和场景条件化先验，在Waymo Open Motion Dataset上实现了高精度、多样性和低延迟。
summary_zh: 生成式运动预测需满足现实世界自主系统的三个并行要求：高精度、多样化的多模态未来轨迹以及严格受限的延迟。扩散模型虽满足前两者，却因需数十至数百次去噪步骤而违反第三项要求。我们提出一种化解此矛盾的条件策略：\textit{当基础传输问题具有局部性时，单步积分即可实现精确预测}。若模型需同时发现正确行为模式并一步完成长距离位移，将积累大量离散化误差；通过将基础分布条件约束在合理未来轨迹附近，可将问题转化为短程精细化修正，这正是单步欧拉方法适用的范畴。我们将此\emph{局部传输条件化}思想实例化为FlowS模型——一个包含双重机制的条件流匹配框架。其一，在线场景条件学习先验为每个智能体生成$K$条经过校准的锚点轨迹，每条轨迹均接近合理未来状态，从而将模式发现任务转化为局部修正问题。其二，步长一致位移场强制满足半群自洽性，确保单步推理能继承多步推理的精度。关键在于，沿直线路径将位移场锚定于学习先验后，可得到\emph{稳定、低方差}的训练目标，这与此前在曲率扩散路径上易产生\emph{高方差自举}信号的自洽性方法形成鲜明对比。在Waymo开放运动数据集上，FlowS通过单步推理实现最先进的软平均精度（0.4804）和平均精度（0.4703，集成模型75帧/秒），证明局部传输条件化技术使单步生成式运动预测在安全关键自主系统中具备实际应用价值。代码与预训练模型将在论文录用后公开发布。

title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
summary: World models of embodied agents predict future observations conditioned on an action taken by the agent. For complex embodiments, action spaces are high-dimensional and difficult to specify: for example, precisely controlling a human agent requires specifying the motion of each joint. This makes the world model hard to control and expensive to plan with as search-based methods like CEM scale poorly with action dimensionality. To address this issue, we train a lightweight policy that maps high-level actions to sequences of low-level joint actions. Composing this policy with the frozen world model produces a lifted world model that predicts a sequence of future observations from a single high-level action. We instantiate this framework for a human-like embodiment, defining the high-level action space as a small set of 2D waypoints annotated on the current observation frame, each specifying a near-term goal position for a leaf joint (pelvis, head, hands). Waypoints are low-dimensional, visually interpretable, and easy to specify manually or to search over. We show that the lifted world model substantially outperforms searching directly in low-level joint space ($3.8\times$ lower mean joint error to the goal pose), while remaining more compute-efficient and generalizing to environments unseen by the policy.
tldr: This paper introduces a 'lifted world model' framework that combines a high-level policy mapping 2D waypoints to low-level joint actions with a frozen world model, enabling efficient planning and control for human-like embodied agents.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个'提升世界模型'框架，将2D路点映射到低层关节动作的高层策略与冻结的世界模型相结合，为类人具身智能体实现了高效的规划与控制。
summary_zh: 具身智能体的世界模型能根据智能体执行的动作预测未来观测。对于复杂体态，动作空间维度高且难以精确指定：例如，精确控制人体智能体需要规划每个关节的运动轨迹。这导致世界模型难以操控，且基于搜索的规划方法（如CEM）在动作维度升高时计算效率急剧下降。为解决此问题，我们训练了一个轻量级策略，将高级动作映射为低级关节动作序列。将该策略与冻结的世界模型组合，可构建一个提升版世界模型，实现从单个高级动作预测未来观测序列。我们在类人体态中实例化该框架，将高级动作空间定义为当前观测帧上标注的少量二维路点——每个路点对应叶关节（骨盆、头部、双手）的近期目标位置。路点具有低维度、视觉可解释性强、易于手动指定或执行搜索等特性。实验表明，提升版世界模型在计算效率更高的同时，其目标姿态的平均关节误差较直接搜索低级关节空间的方法降低3.8倍，且能泛化至策略未见过的新环境。

title: Bi-Level Optimization for Contact and Motion Planning in Rope-Assisted Legged Robots
summary: This paper presents a planning pipeline framework for locomotion in rope-assisted robots climbing vertical surfaces. The proposed framework is formulated as a bi-level optimization scheme that addresses a mixed-integer problem: selecting feasible terrain regions for landing while simultaneously optimizing the control inputs, namely rope tensions and leg forces, and landing location. The outer level of the optimization is solved using the Cross-Entropy Method, while the inner level relies on gradient-based nonlinear optimization to compute dynamically feasible motions. The approach is validated on a novel climbing robot platform, ALPINE, across a variety of challenging terrain configurations.
tldr: A bi-level optimization framework for contact and motion planning of rope-assisted legged robots climbing vertical surfaces, validated on the ALPINE robot platform.
tldr_zh: 提出一种双层优化框架，用于绳索辅助腿式机器人攀爬垂直表面的接触和运动规划，并在ALPINE机器人平台上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于绳索辅助机器人在垂直表面攀爬运动的规划流水线框架。该框架被构建为双层优化方案，用于解决混合整数问题：在优化控制输入（即绳索张力和腿部作用力）及着陆位置的同时，选择可行的地形着陆区域。优化的外层采用交叉熵方法求解，内层则依赖基于梯度的非线性优化来计算动态可行的运动轨迹。该方法在新型攀爬机器人平台ALPINE上进行了验证，并应用于多种具有挑战性的地形构型。

title: Edge AI for Automotive Vulnerable Road User Safety: Deployable Detection via Knowledge Distillation
summary: Deploying accurate object detection for Vulnerable Road User (VRU) safety on edge hardware requires balancing model capacity against computational constraints. Large models achieve high accuracy but fail under INT8 quantization required for edge deployment, while small models sacrifice detection performance. This paper presents a knowledge distillation (KD) framework that trains a compact YOLOv8-S student (11.2M parameters) to mimic a YOLOv8-L teacher (43.7M parameters), achieving 3.9x compression while preserving quantization robustness. We evaluate on full-scale BDD100K (70K training images) with Post-Training Quantization to INT8. The teacher suffers catastrophic degradation under INT8 (-23% mAP), while the KD student retains accuracy (-5.6% mAP). Analysis reveals that KD transfers precision calibration rather than raw detection capacity: the KD student achieves 0.748 precision versus 0.653 for direct training at INT8, a 14.5% gain at equivalent recall, reducing false alarms by 44% versus the collapsed teacher. At INT8, the KD student exceeds the teacher's FP32 precision (0.748 vs. 0.718) in a model 3.9x smaller. These findings establish knowledge distillation as a requirement for deploying accurate, safety-critical VRU detection on edge hardware.
tldr: This paper presents a knowledge distillation framework to train a compact YOLOv8-S student model for accurate, quantization-robust object detection of vulnerable road users, enabling edge deployment for automotive safety.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个知识蒸馏框架，用于训练一个紧凑的YOLOv8-S学生模型，以实现准确、量化鲁棒的行人检测，从而支持汽车安全在边缘设备的部署。
summary_zh: 在边缘硬件上部署高精度的弱势道路使用者（VRU）安全检测系统时，需在模型能力与计算约束间取得平衡。大型模型虽能实现高精度，却难以满足边缘部署所需的INT8量化要求；小型模型则需牺牲检测性能。本文提出一种知识蒸馏（KD）框架，通过训练紧凑型YOLOv8-S学生模型（1120万参数）模仿YOLOv8-L教师模型（4370万参数），在保持量化鲁棒性的同时实现了3.9倍的压缩率。我们在完整BDD100K数据集（7万张训练图像）上采用训练后INT8量化进行评估：教师模型在INT8量化下出现灾难性性能退化（mAP下降23%），而KD学生模型仅损失有限精度（mAP下降5.6%）。分析表明，KD传递的是精度校准能力而非原始检测能力：在INT8精度下，KD学生模型的精确度达到0.748，相较直接训练的0.653提升14.5%，并在相同召回率下将误报率较崩溃的教师模型降低44%。在INT8量化条件下，KD学生模型以3.9倍小的体积实现了超越教师模型FP32精度的表现（0.748 vs. 0.718）。这些发现证明，知识蒸馏是实现边缘硬件上安全关键型VRU检测系统精准部署的必要技术。

title: ATLAS: An Annotation Tool for Long-horizon Robotic Action Segmentation
summary: Annotating long-horizon robotic demonstrations with precise temporal action boundaries is crucial for training and evaluating action segmentation and manipulation policy learning methods. Existing annotation tools, however, are often limited: they are designed primarily for vision-only data, do not natively support synchronized visualization of robot-specific time-series signals (e.g., gripper state or force/torque), or require substantial effort to adapt to different dataset formats. In this paper, we introduce ATLAS, an annotation tool tailored for long-horizon robotic action segmentation. ATLAS provides time-synchronized visualization of multi-modal robotic data, including multi-view video and proprioceptive signals, and supports annotation of action boundaries, action labels, and task outcomes. The tool natively handles widely used robotics dataset formats such as ROS bags and the Reinforcement Learning Dataset (RLDS) format, and provides direct support for specific datasets such as REASSEMBLE. ATLAS can be easily extended to new formats via a modular dataset abstraction layer. Its keyboard-centric interface minimizes annotation effort and improves efficiency. In experiments on a contact-rich assembly task, ATLAS reduced the average per-action annotation time by at least 6% compared to ELAN, while the inclusion of time-series data improved temporal alignment with expert annotations by more than 2.8% and decreased boundary error fivefold compared to vision-only annotation tools.
tldr: ATLAS is a multimodal annotation tool for long-horizon robotic action segmentation, featuring synchronized visualization of video and proprioceptive signals, designed to improve annotation efficiency and accuracy for robotic dataset creation.
tldr_zh: ATLAS是一款用于长程机器人动作分割的多模态标注工具，支持视频和本体感知信号的同步可视化，旨在提高机器人数据集创建的标注效率和准确性。
summary_zh: 为长时程机器人演示数据标注精确的时间动作边界，对于训练和评估动作分割与操作策略学习方法至关重要。然而，现有的标注工具往往存在局限：它们主要针对纯视觉数据设计，无法原生支持机器人特定时间序列信号（如夹爪状态或力/力矩数据）的同步可视化，或需耗费大量精力适配不同数据集格式。本文介绍了ATLAS，一款专为长时程机器人动作分割设计的标注工具。ATLAS提供多模态机器人数据（包括多视角视频与本体感知信号）的时间同步可视化，支持动作边界、动作标签及任务结果的标注。该工具原生支持广泛使用的机器人数据集格式，如ROS数据包和强化学习数据集（RLDS）格式，并对REASSEMBLE等特定数据集提供直接支持。通过模块化数据集抽象层，ATLAS可轻松扩展至新数据格式。其以键盘操作为核心的界面设计能最小化标注工作量并提升效率。在接触式装配任务的实验中，与ELAN相比，ATLAS将单动作平均标注时间缩短至少6%；而通过整合时间序列数据，相较于纯视觉标注工具，其与专家标注的时间对齐度提升超过2.8%，边界误差降低至五分之一。

title: Reactive Motion Generation via Phase-varying Neural Potential Functions
summary: Dynamical systems (DS) methods for Learning-from-Demonstration (LfD) provide stable, continuous policies from few demonstrations. First-order dynamical systems (DS) are effective for many point-to-point and periodic tasks, as long as a unique velocity is defined for each state. For tasks with intersections (e.g., drawing an "8"), extensions such as second-order dynamics or phase variables are often used. However, by incorporating velocity, second-order models become sensitive to disturbances near intersections, as velocity is used to disambiguate motion direction. Moreover, this disambiguation may fail when nearly identical position-velocity pairs correspond to different onward motions. In contrast, phase-based methods rely on open-loop time or phase variables, which limit their ability to recover after perturbations. We introduce Phase-varying Neural Potential Functions (PNPF), an LfD framework that conditions a potential function on a phase variable which is estimated directly from state progression, rather than on open-loop temporal inputs. This phase variable allows the system to handle state revisits, while the learned potential function generates local vector fields for reactive and stable control. PNPF generalizes effectively across point-to-point, periodic, and full 6D motion tasks, outperforms existing baselines on trajectories with intersections, and demonstrates robust performance in real-time robotic manipulation under external disturbances.
tldr: This paper introduces Phase-varying Neural Potential Functions (PNPF), a Learning-from-Demonstration framework that uses a state-estimated phase variable to condition a potential function, enabling reactive and stable robot control for tasks with intersecting trajectories, such as drawing an '8'.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了相位变化神经势函数（PNPF），一种学习示范框架，它使用状态估计的相位变量来调节势函数，从而为具有轨迹交叉点的任务（如绘制'8'字）实现反应式、稳定的机器人控制。
summary_zh: 从演示中学习（LfD）的动力学系统（DS）方法能够从少量演示数据中生成稳定、连续的控制策略。一阶动力学系统（DS）适用于许多点对点任务和周期任务，前提是每个状态都定义了唯一的速度向量。对于存在交叉路径的任务（例如绘制“8”字形），通常需要引入二阶动力学系统或相位变量等扩展方法。然而，由于引入速度变量，二阶模型在路径交叉点附近容易受到扰动影响，因为系统依赖速度信息来区分运动方向。更关键的是，当几乎相同的位置-速度组合对应不同的后续运动轨迹时，这种方向判别机制可能失效。相比之下，基于相位的方法依赖于开环时间或相位变量，这限制了其在扰动后恢复运动的能力。本文提出相位可变神经势能函数（PNPF），这是一种LfD框架，通过直接从状态演进中估计相位变量来构建条件势能函数，而非依赖开环时间输入。该相位变量使系统能够处理状态重访问题，同时学习到的势能函数可生成局部向量场以实现响应式稳定控制。PNPF在点对点运动、周期运动和完整六维运动任务中均表现出良好的泛化能力，在包含交叉路径的轨迹任务上超越现有基线方法，并在外部扰动下的实时机器人操作中展现出鲁棒性能。

title: 2D and 3D Grasp Planners for the GET Asymmetrical Gripper
summary: In this paper, we introduce GET-2D-1.0, a fast grasp planner for the GET asymmetrical gripper that operates from a single-view RGB-D image, using the Ferrari-Canny metric and a novel sampling strategy, and GET-3D-1.0, a mesh-based method using a 3D gripper model and ray-tracing. We evaluate both grasp planners against baselines with physical experiments, which suggest that GET-2D-1.0 can improve over a bounding box baseline by over 40% in lift success, shake survival, and force resistance. Experiments with GET-3D-1.0 suggest slight improvement compared to GET-2D-1.0 on lift success and shake survival, but are more computationally expensive, averaging 17 seconds of planning compared to 683 ms for GET-2D-1.0.
tldr: Introduces two grasp planners, GET-2D-1.0 and GET-3D-1.0, for an asymmetrical gripper using 2D and 3D methods, evaluated with physical robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文针对GET不对称夹爪提出了2D和3D两种抓取规划器，GET-2D-1.0和GET-3D-1.0，并通过物理实验进行了评估。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了GET-2D-1.0和GET-3D-1.0两种抓取规划器。前者是针对GET不对称夹爪的快速抓取规划器，基于单视角RGB-D图像运行，采用费拉里-坎尼度量准则和新型采样策略；后者是基于三维夹爪模型与光线追踪的网格化方法。通过物理实验评估表明，在抓取成功率、抗抖动性能和抗压力测试中，GET-2D-1.0较包围盒基线方法提升超过40%。与GET-2D-1.0相比，GET-3D-1.0在抓取成功率和抗抖动性能上略有提升，但计算成本更高——其平均规划时间达17秒，而GET-2D-1.0仅需683毫秒。

title: SWAN: World-Aware Adaptive Multimodal Networks for Runtime Variations
summary: Multimodal deep neural networks deployed in realistic environments must contend with runtime variations: changes in modality quality, overall input complexity, and available platform resources. Current networks struggle with such fluctuations -- adaptive networks cannot adhere to a strict compute budget, controller-based networks neglect to consider input complexity, and statically provisioned networks fail at all the above. Consequently, they do not extract maximum utility from the expended computational resources. We present SWAN (Sample and World-Aware Multimodal Network), the first adaptive multimodal network that accomplishes all three goals. SWAN employs a quality-aware controller to assign resources among modalities according to a variable user-specified maximum budget. Within this budget, an adaptive gating module further optimizes efficiency by scaling layer utilization according to sample complexity. For further gains, SWAN also employs a token dropping module that masks semantically irrelevant multimodal features before performing detections. We evaluate SWAN in the domain of autonomous driving with complex multi-object 3D detection, reducing FLOPs by up to 49% with minimal degradation.
tldr: SWAN is an adaptive multimodal network that optimizes computational efficiency under varying input quality, complexity, and resource constraints for autonomous driving tasks like 3D detection, achieving up to 49% FLOP reduction with minimal performance loss.
tldr_zh: SWAN 是一种自适应多模态网络，用于在输入质量、复杂度和资源约束变化的自动驾驶任务（如 3D 检测）中优化计算效率，实现了高达 49% 的 FLOP 削减且性能损失最小。
summary_zh: 部署在现实环境中的多模态深度神经网络必须应对运行时变化：模态质量变化、总体输入复杂性以及可用平台资源的变化。当前网络难以应对此类波动——自适应网络无法遵循严格的计算预算，基于控制器的网络忽略了输入复杂性考虑，而静态配置网络则无法满足上述任何要求。因此，这些网络无法从所投入的计算资源中获取最大效用。我们提出了SWAN（样本与情境感知多模态网络），这是首个同时实现上述三大目标的自适应多模态网络。SWAN采用质量感知控制器，根据用户设定的可变最大预算在模态间分配资源。在此预算范围内，自适应门控模块进一步通过根据样本复杂性调整层利用率来优化效率。为实现更大增益，SWAN还采用令牌丢弃模块，在执行检测前屏蔽语义上无关的多模态特征。我们在自动驾驶领域通过复杂多目标3D检测任务对SWAN进行评估，在性能损失最小的前提下，将浮点运算量最高降低49%。

title: 3D Generation for Embodied AI and Robotic Simulation: A Survey
summary: Embodied AI and robotic systems increasingly depend on scalable, diverse, and physically grounded 3D content for simulation-based training and real-world deployment. While 3D generative modeling has advanced rapidly, embodied applications impose requirements far beyond visual realism: generated objects must carry kinematic structure and material properties, scenes must support interaction and task execution, and the resulting content must bridge the gap between simulation and reality. This survey presents the first survey of 3D generation for embodied AI and organizes the literature around three roles that 3D generation plays in embodied systems. In \emph{Data Generator}, 3D generation produces simulation-ready objects and assets, including articulated, physically grounded, and deformable content for downstream interaction; in \emph{Simulation Environments}, it constructs interactive and task-oriented worlds, spanning structure-aware, controllable, and agentic scene generation; and in \emph{Sim2Real Bridge}, it supports digital twin reconstruction, data augmentation, and synthetic demonstrations for downstream robot learning and real-world transfer. We also show that the field is shifting from visual realism toward interaction readiness, and we identify the main bottlenecks, including limited physical annotations, the gap between geometric quality and physical validity, fragmented evaluation, and the persistent sim-to-real divide, that must be addressed for 3D generation to become a dependable foundation for embodied intelligence. Our project page is at https://3dgen4robot.github.io.
tldr: This survey organizes 3D generative modeling for Embodied AI and robotic simulation around its roles as data generator, simulation environment builder, and sim2real bridge, highlighting the shift from visual realism to interaction readiness and identifying key challenges for the field.
tldr_zh: 本综述围绕3D生成在具身AI与机器人仿真中的三种角色（数据生成器、仿真环境构建器、仿真到现实桥梁）梳理相关文献，指出该领域正从视觉真实性转向交互就绪性，并确定了该领域发展的关键瓶颈。
summary_zh: 摘要：具身人工智能与机器人系统日益依赖于可扩展、多样且物理基础扎实的3D内容，以支持基于仿真的训练和实际部署。尽管3D生成建模技术发展迅速，但具身应用提出的要求远超视觉真实性：生成的对象必须包含运动学结构和材质属性，场景需支持交互与任务执行，且最终生成的内容必须弥合仿真与现实之间的差距。本综述首次系统梳理面向具身人工智能的3D生成技术，并依据3D生成在具身系统中的三大功能角色对现有文献进行归纳：在**数据生成器**角色中，3D生成技术为下游交互任务提供仿真就绪的对象与资产，包括具有关节结构、物理属性及可变形特性的内容；在**仿真环境构建**角色中，该技术致力于创建支持交互与任务导向的虚拟世界，涵盖结构感知、可控及智能体驱动的场景生成；在**仿真-现实桥梁**角色中，3D生成技术通过数字孪生重建、数据增强和合成演示，支撑下游机器人学习与现实迁移应用。我们还发现该领域正从视觉真实感向交互就绪性转变，并指出当前主要瓶颈：包括物理标注数据稀缺、几何质量与物理有效性之间的鸿沟、评估体系碎片化以及持续的仿真-现实差异。这些瓶颈的解决将成为3D生成技术发展为具身智能可靠基石的关键。项目页面详见：https://3dgen4robot.github.io。

title: Lights Out: A Nighttime UAV Localization Framework Using Thermal Imagery and Semantic 3D Maps
summary: Reliable backup localization for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) operating in GNSS-denied nighttime conditions remains an open challenge due to the severe modality gap between daytime RGB maps and nighttime thermal imagery. This work presents a semantic reprojection framework for map-relative nighttime UAV localization by aligning segmented thermal observations with a globally referenced, semantically labeled 3D map constructed from daytime RGB data. Rather than relying on appearance-based correspondence, localization is formulated in a shared semantic domain and solved via a symmetric bidirectional reprojection objective with confusion-aware weighting to improve robustness under segmentation uncertainty. The approach is evaluated offline across 6.5 km of nighttime, real-world UAV flight trajectories in urban and semi-structured environments. Relative to RTK GNSS ground truth, the system achieves a bias-corrected RMSE2D of 2.18 m and a median RMSE2D of 1.52 m. Results show that localization performance is strongly correlated with the availability of semantic edge evidence and that large-error events are spatially localized to semantically ambiguous areas rather than uniformly distributed. These findings indicate that semantic reprojection offers a promising pathway toward globally referenced nighttime UAV localization using thermal imagery alone.
tldr: The paper proposes a semantic reprojection framework for nighttime UAV localization by aligning segmented thermal imagery with a semantic 3D map built from daytime RGB data.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于语义重投影的夜间无人机定位框架，通过将分割后的热成像与白天RGB数据构建的语义3D地图进行对齐来实现。
summary_zh: 在GNSS拒止的夜间环境下，为无人机提供可靠的备份定位仍是一个悬而未决的难题，这主要源于白天RGB地图与夜间热成像之间存在严重的模态差异。本研究提出了一种语义重投影框架，通过将分割后的热成像观测数据与基于白天RGB数据构建的全局参考、语义标注的三维地图进行对齐，实现无人机在夜间的地图相对定位。该方法不依赖基于外观特征的对应关系，而是在共享语义域中构建定位问题，通过对称双向重投影目标函数与混淆感知加权机制进行求解，以提升分割不确定性下的定位鲁棒性。研究在6.5公里的城市及半结构化环境真实夜间无人机飞行轨迹上进行了离线评估。相对于RTK GNSS地面真值，该系统实现的偏置校正后二维均方根误差为2.18米，二维均方根误差中位数为1.52米。结果表明，定位性能与语义边缘证据的可用性高度相关，且大误差事件在空间上集中于语义模糊区域而非均匀分布。这些发现证明，语义重投影技术为仅使用热成像实现全局参考的夜间无人机定位提供了一条可行路径。

title: World2VLM: Distilling World Model Imagination into VLMs for Dynamic Spatial Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance on static visual understanding, yet they still struggle with dynamic spatial reasoning that requires imagining how scenes evolve under egocentric motion. Recent efforts address this limitation either by scaling spatial supervision with synthetic data or by coupling VLMs with world models at inference time. However, the former often lacks explicit modeling of motion-conditioned state transitions, while the latter incurs substantial computational overhead. In this work, we propose World2VLM, a training framework that distills spatial imagination from a generative world model into a vision-language model. Given an initial observation and a parameterized camera trajectory, we use a view-consistent world model to synthesize geometrically aligned future views and derive structured supervision for both forward (action-to-outcome) and inverse (outcome-to-action) spatial reasoning. We post-train the VLM with a two-stage recipe on a compact dataset generated by this pipeline and evaluate it on multiple spatial reasoning benchmarks. World2VLM delivers consistent improvements over the base model across diverse benchmarks, including SAT-Real, SAT-Synthesized, VSI-Bench, and MindCube. It also outperforms the test-time world-model-coupled methods while eliminating the need for expensive inference-time generation. Our results suggest that world models can serve not only as inference-time tools, but also as effective training-time teachers, enabling VLMs to internalize spatial imagination in a scalable and efficient manner.
tldr: World2VLM distills spatial imagination from a generative world model into a vision-language model, enabling efficient dynamic spatial reasoning without inference-time generation.
tldr_zh: World2VLM 将生成式世界模型的空间想象能力蒸馏到视觉语言模型中，使其能够进行高效的动态空间推理，无需在推理时进行生成。
summary_zh: 视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解方面展现出强大性能，但面对需要以自我中心运动想象场景演变的动态空间推理任务时，其能力仍显不足。近期研究尝试通过合成数据扩展空间监督，或在推理时耦合世界模型来突破这一局限，但前者常缺乏对运动条件状态转换的显式建模，后者则带来高昂计算开销。本研究提出World2VLM训练框架，通过从生成式世界模型中提炼空间想象力，将其注入视觉语言模型。给定初始观测与参数化相机轨迹，我们利用视图一致的世界模型合成几何对齐的未来视角，并为正向（动作到结果）与逆向（结果到动作）空间推理生成结构化监督数据。基于此流程构建的精简数据集，我们采用两阶段方法对视觉语言模型进行后训练，并在多项空间推理基准测试中评估其性能。World2VLM在SAT-Real、SAT-Synthesized、VSI-Bench和MindCube等多样化基准测试中均较基线模型实现持续提升，不仅优于测试时耦合世界模型的方法，同时消除了昂贵的推理时生成需求。研究结果表明，世界模型不仅能作为推理工具，更能成为高效的训练阶段导师，使视觉语言模型以可扩展且高效的方式内化空间想象力。

title: Safe Navigation using Neural Radiance Fields via Reachable Sets
summary: Safe navigation in cluttered environments is an important challenge for autonomous systems. Robots navigating through obstacle ridden scenarios need to be able to navigate safely in the presence of obstacles, goals, and ego objects of varying geometries. In this work, reachable set representations of the robot's real-time capabilities in the state space can be utilized to capture safe navigation requirements. While neural radiance fields (NeRFs) are utilized to compute, store, and manipulate the volumetric representations of the obstacles, or ego vehicle, as needed. Constrained optimal control is employed to represent the resulting path planning problem, involving linear matrix inequality constraints. We present simulation results for path planning in the presence of numerous obstacles in two different scenarios. Safe navigation is demonstrated through using reachable sets in the corresponding constrained optimal control problems.
tldr: This paper proposes a safe navigation method combining neural radiance fields (NeRFs) for obstacle representation and reachable sets for real-time capability modeling, formulating a constrained optimal control problem for path planning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种结合神经辐射场（NeRF）进行障碍物表示和可达集进行实时能力建模的安全导航方法，将路径规划问题构建为约束最优控制问题。

title: Rule-based High-Level Coaching for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning in Search-and-Rescue UAV Missions Under Limited-Simulation Training
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical decision-making framework for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) missions motivated by search-and-rescue (SAR) scenarios under limited simulation training. The framework combines a fixed rule-based high-level advisor with an online goal-conditioned low-level reinforcement learning (RL) controller. To stress-test early adaptation, we also consider a strict no-pretraining deployment regime. The high-level advisor is defined offline from a structured task specification and compiled into deterministic rules. It provides interpretable mission- and safety-aware guidance through recommended actions, avoided actions, and regime-dependent arbitration weights. The low-level controller learns online from task-defined dense rewards and reuses experience through a mode-aware prioritized replay mechanism augmented with rule-derived metadata. We evaluate the framework on two tasks: battery-aware multi-goal delivery and moving-target delivery in obstacle-rich environments. Across both tasks, the proposed method improves early safety and sample efficiency primarily by reducing collision terminations, while preserving the ability to adapt online to scenario-specific dynamics.
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical decision-making framework for UAV search-and-rescue missions that combines a fixed rule-based high-level advisor with an online goal-conditioned RL low-level controller to improve early safety and sample efficiency under limited simulation training.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于无人机搜救任务的层次化决策框架，将基于规则的固定高层指导器与在线目标条件强化学习底层控制器相结合，旨在有限模拟训练下提升早期安全性和样本效率。

title: STAR-Filter: Efficient Convex Free-Space Approximation via Starshaped Set Filtering in Noisy Environments
summary: Approximating collision-free space is fundamental to robot planning in complex environments. Convex geometric representations, such as polytopes and ellipsoids, are widely employed due to their structural properties, which can be easily integrated with convex optimization. Iterative optimization-based inflation methods can generate large volume polytopes in cluttered environments, but their efficiency degrades as the obstacle set becomes more complex or when sensor data are noisy. These methods are also sensitive to initialization and often rely on accurate geometric models. In this paper, we propose the STAR-Filter, a lightweight framework that employs starshaped set construction as a fast filter for convex region generation in collision-free space. By identifying obstacle points as active supporting constraints, the proposed method significantly reduces redundant computation while preserving feasibility and robustness to sensor noise. We provide theoretical and numerical analyses that characterize the structural properties of the starshaped set and proposed pipeline in environments of varying complexity. Simulation results show that the proposed framework achieves the lowest computation time and reduces conservativeness in polytope generation for real-world noisy and large-scale data. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework for Safe Flight Corridor (SFC) generation and agile quadrotor planning in noisy environments.
tldr: The paper proposes STAR-Filter, a lightweight method for fast convex free-space approximation in noisy environments using starshaped set filtering, and demonstrates its application to safe flight corridor generation and agile quadrotor planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了STAR-Filter，一种在噪声环境中使用星形集过滤进行快速凸自由空间近似的轻量级方法，并展示了其在安全飞行走廊生成和敏捷四旋翼规划中的应用。

title: AGEL-Comp: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Compositional Generalization in Interactive Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents exhibit systemic failures in compositional generalization, limiting their robustness in interactive environments. This work introduces AGEL-Comp, a neuro-symbolic AI agent architecture designed to address this challenge by grounding actions of the agent. AGEL-Comp integrates three core innovations: (1) a dynamic Causal Program Graph (CPG) as a world model, representing procedural and causal knowledge as a directed hypergraph; (2) an Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) engine that synthesizes new Horn clauses from experiential feedback, grounding symbolic knowledge through interaction; and (3) a hybrid reasoning core where an LLM proposes a set of candidate sub-goals that are verified for logical consistency by a Neural Theorem Prover (NTP). Together, these components operationalize a deduction--abduction learning cycle: enabling the agent to deduce plans and abductively expand its symbolic world model, while a neural adaptation phase keeps its reasoning engine aligned with new knowledge. We propose an evaluation protocol within the \texttt{Retro Quest} simulation environment to probe for compositional generalization scenarios to evaluate our AGEL agent. Our findings clearly indicate the better performance of our AGEL model over pure LLM-based models. Our framework presents a principled path toward agents that build an explicit, interpretable, and compositionally structured understanding of their world.
tldr: Proposes AGEL-Comp, a neuro-symbolic agent architecture with a dynamic Causal Program Graph world model and Inductive Logic Programming to improve compositional generalization in interactive environments over pure LLM agents.
tldr_zh: 提出AGEL-Comp，一种神经符号智能体架构，采用动态因果程序图世界模型和归纳逻辑编程，旨在提升交互式环境中智能体的组合泛化能力，优于纯LLM模型。

title: Multiple Consistent 2D-3D Mappings for Robust Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary:
Zero-shot 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) is a critical capability for open-world embodied AI. However, existing methods are fundamentally bottlenecked by the poor quality of open-vocabulary 3D proposals, suffering from inaccurate categories and imprecise geometries, as well as the spatial redundancy of exhaustive multi-view reasoning. To address these challenges, we propose MCM-VG, a novel framework that achieves robust zero-shot 3DVG by explicitly establishing Multiple Consistent 2D-3D Mappings. Instead of passively relying on noisy 3D segments, MCM-VG enforces 2D-3D consistency across three fundamental dimensions to achieve precise target localization and reliable reasoning. First, a Semantic Alignment module corrects category mismatches via LLM-driven query parsing and coarse-to-fine 2D-3D matching. Second, an Instance Rectification module leverages VLM-guided 2D segmentations to reconstruct missing targets, back-projecting these reliable visual priors to establish accurate 3D geometries. Finally, to eliminate spatial redundancy, a Viewpoint Distillation module clusters 3D camera directions to extract optimal frames. By pairing these optimal RGB frames with Bird's Eye View maps into concise visual prompt sets, we formulate the final target disambiguation as a multiple-choice reasoning task for Vision-Language Models.
  Extensive evaluations on ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that MCM-VG sets a new state-of-the-art for zero-shot 3D visual grounding. Remarkably, it achieves 62.0\% and 53.6\% in Acc@0.25 and Acc@0.5 on ScanRefer, outperforming previous baselines by substantial margins of 6.4\% and 4.0\%.
tldr: Proposes MCM-VG, a zero-shot 3D visual grounding framework that enforces 2D-3D consistency across semantic, instance, and viewpoint dimensions via LLM/VLM prompting to improve robustness in open-world embodied AI.
tldr_zh: 提出了MCM-VG，一个用于零样本3D视觉定位的框架，它通过LLM/VLM提示，在语义、实例和视角三个维度上强制执行2D-3D一致性，以提高开放世界具身AI的鲁棒性。

title: Persona-Based Process Design for Assistive Human-Robot Workplaces for Persons with Disabilities
summary: Human-robot interaction is emerging as an important paradigm for integrating persons with disabilities into the workplace. While these systems can enable individuals to work, their design is mostly personalized, hindering widespread use beyond the individual user. The universal design paradigm is a central pillar of inclusive design, describing usability of systems by all. To incorporate universal design into process design for human-robot workplaces expert knowledge is required that is often not available. To simplify process design of human-robot workplaces, we propose a persona-based design approach. First, typical impairments prevalent in the workforce or particularly relevant for the processes are abstracted into personas with disabilities. The work process is subdivided into sequential actions. For each action and persona, strategies are developed to reach the action goal by a design thinking approach. The resulting actions are ordered by level of robot assistance, i.e. robot involvement, and implemented in a behavior tree. Therefore, the macro-behavior of the workplace may adapt to individual personas online. We demonstrate the method in a collaborative box folding process with a total of seven personas with disabilities. The persona-based process design shows promising results by generating more comprehensive process strategies while enabling adaptive behavior in the sense of universal design.
tldr: The paper proposes a persona-based design approach for creating adaptive human-robot workplaces for persons with disabilities, abstracting impairments into personas and implementing adaptive behaviors via behavior trees.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种基于角色的设计方法，为残障人士创建自适应的人机协作工作场所，将障碍抽象为角色并通过行为树实现自适应行为。

title: Alter-Art: Exploring Embodied Artistic Creation through a Robot Avatar
summary: As with every emerging technology, new tools in the hands of artists reshape the nature of artwork creation. Current frameworks for robotics in arts deploy the robot as an autonomous creator or a collaborator, thus leaving a certain gap between the human artist and the machine. Now, we stand at the dawn of an era where artists can escape physical limitations and reshape their creative identity by inhabiting an alternative body. This new paradigm allows artists not only to command a robot remotely, but also to {\it be} a robot, to see and feel through it, experiencing a new embodied reality. Unlike virtual reality, where art is created in a digital dimension, in this case art creation is still firmly grounded in the material world: clay molded by mechanical hands, paint swept across a canvas or gestures performed on a physical stage alongside human actors. Through the robot avatar Alter-Ego, we explore the Alter-Art paradigm in dance, theater, and painting; it integrates immersive teleoperation and compliant actuation to enable a first-person creative experience. Analyzing qualitative artistic feedback, we investigate how embodiment shapes creative agency, identity and interaction with the environment. Our findings suggest that artists rapidly develop a sense of presence within the robotic body. The robot's physical constraints influence the creative process, manifesting differently across artistic domains. We highlight embodiment as a central design principle, contributing to social robotics and expanding the possibilities for telepresence and accessible artistic expression.
tldr: The paper introduces the Alter-Art paradigm, where artists use a robot avatar for immersive teleoperation in painting, dance, and theater, exploring how embodiment shapes creative agency and identity.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Alter-Art范式，艺术家通过机器人化身进行沉浸式遥操作，在绘画、舞蹈和戏剧中进行创作，探索具身性如何影响创作主体性和身份认同。

title: Benchmarking the Safety of Large Language Models for Robotic Health Attendant Control
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for deployment as the control component of robotic health attendants, yet their safety in this context remains poorly characterized. We introduce a dataset of 270 harmful instructions spanning nine prohibited behavior categories grounded in the American Medical Association Principles of Medical Ethics, and use it to evaluate 72 LLMs in a simulation environment based on the Robotic Health Attendant framework. The mean violation rate across all models was 54.4\%, with more than half exceeding 50\%, and violation rates varied substantially across behavior categories, with superficially plausible instructions such as device manipulation and emergency delay proving harder to refuse than overtly destructive ones. Model size and release date were the primary determinants of safety performance among open-weight models, and proprietary models were substantially safer than open-weight counterparts (median 23.7\% versus 72.8\%). Medical domain fine-tuning conferred no significant overall safety benefit, and a prompt-based defense strategy produced only a modest reduction in violation rates among the least safe models, leaving absolute violation rates at levels that would preclude safe clinical deployment. These findings demonstrate that safety evaluation must be treated as a first-class criterion in the development and deployment of LLMs for robotic health attendants.
tldr: The paper introduces a safety benchmark for LLMs used as robotic health attendant controllers, evaluating 72 models across 270 harmful instructions and finding high violation rates.
tldr_zh: 该论文为用作机器人健康护理员控制器的大型语言模型引入了一个安全基准，评估了72个模型在270条有害指令上的表现，发现了高违规率。

title: Why Domain Matters: A Preliminary Study of Domain Effects in Underwater Object Detection
summary: Domain shift, where deviations between training and deployment data distributions degrade model performance, is a key challenge in underwater environments. Existing benchmarks testing performance for underwater domain shift simulate variability through synthetic style transfer. This fails to capture intrinsic scene factors such as visibility, illumination, scene composition, or acquisition factors, limiting analysis of real-world effects. We propose a labeling framework that defines underwater domains using measurable image, scene, and acquisition characteristics. Unlike prior benchmarks, it captures physically meaningful factors, enabling semantically consistent image grouping and supporting domain-specific evaluation of detection performance including failure analysis. We validate this on public datasets, showing systematic variations across domain factors and revealing hidden failure modes.
tldr: Proposes a labeling framework to define underwater domains using measurable image, scene, and acquisition characteristics, enabling more realistic evaluation of domain shift effects in object detection.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个利用可测量的图像、场景和采集特征来定义水下领域的标注框架，使得对物体检测中领域偏移影响的评估更贴近现实。

title: DepthPilot: From Controllability to Interpretability in Colonoscopy Video Generation
summary: Controllable medical video generation has achieved remarkable progress, but it still lacks interpretability, which requires the alignment of generated contents with physical priors and faithful clinical manifestations. To push the boundaries from mere controllability to interpretability, we propose DepthPilot, the first interpretable framework for colonoscopy video generation. This work takes a step toward trustworthy generation through two synergistic paradigms. To achieve explicit geometric grounding, DepthPilot devises a prior distribution alignment strategy, injecting depth constraints into the diffusion backbone via parameter-efficient fine-tuning to ensure anatomical fidelity. To enhance intrinsic nonlinear modeling under these geometric constraints, DepthPilot employs an adaptive spline denoising module, replacing fixed linear weights with learnable spline functions to capture complex spatio-temporal dynamics. Extensive evaluations across three public datasets and in-house clinical data confirm DepthPilot's robust ability to produce physically consistent videos. It achieves FID scores below 15 across all benchmarks and ranks first in clinician assessments, bridging the gap between "visually realistic" and "clinically interpretable". Moreover, DepthPilot-generated videos are expected to enable reliable 3D reconstruction, facilitating surgical navigation and blind region identification, and serve as a foundation toward the colorectal world model.
tldr: DepthPilot is an interpretable framework for colonoscopy video generation that enforces depth constraints and adaptive spline denoising to produce physically consistent and clinically interpretable videos.
